chapter: Bass playing, avant-garde and the state of the music
title: The music he enjoys: straight-ahead and form
summary: Ware loves straight-ahead playing with form and praises Ray Brown, Sam Jones and Bob Cranshaw.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: If you had your choice of things that you like to play, what kinds of things would you say you really enjoy playing?

Well, I just enjoy straight-ahead music. What I mean by "straight-ahead" is pick a tune with some changes and within those changes, do whatever we wanted to. I like form. That's my personal thing. I loved listening to Ray Brown do it and, oh, so many people -- Sam Jones -- talking about bass players -- Cecil McBee (PHONETIC) goes out a little bit.
What about people like Bob Cranshaw, Victor Gaskin?
